# Logging & Observability Requirements Checklist: Improve Logging

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for removing V* logging wrappers and enhancing rclone download observability.
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all five V* methods (VInfo, VWarning, VError, VErrorWithError, VFatalf) explicitly enumerated as removal targets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all call sites of removed methods identified and listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the preservation of the `[name]: ` prefix specified as a requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are rclone timing requirements specified for both Cat and CopyTo? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are stderr capture requirements specified for both rclone methods? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the verbose mode toggle mechanism (constructor bool) documented in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the expected provider (B2) error surfacing behavior specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "elapsed execution time" quantified with units (ms/seconds)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the verbose flag default value explicitly stated (off)? [Clarity, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the format of the retained prefix helper specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "native method" defined (slog Info/Warn/Error)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do logging migration requirements align with constitution Principle IV? [Consistency, Conflict C1]
- [ ] CHK013 Are rclone timing requirements consistent between Cat and CopyTo? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Is SC-001 (zero V* references) objectively verifiable via grep? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Is SC-003 (error contains elapsed time + stderr) objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-004 (provider detail in verbose mode) objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are timeout edge cases (context deadline exceeded) addressed? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are empty-stderr edge cases addressed? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are fatal-exit semantics preservation requirements specified? [Coverage, Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK020 Is the RCLONE_VERBOSE env-to-constructor wiring documented? [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Are assumptions about verbose default (off) documented and justified? [Assumption]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK022 Is the conflict between constitution Principle IV (V* methods) and this feature's removal explicitly acknowledged? [Conflict, Spec §SC]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the SC-004 wording ("absent in non-verbose mode") reconciled with rclone's default stderr? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]
